title: Deep learning spleen volume model predicts hepatic decompensation in compensated cirrhosis
summary: In 689 people with compensated cirrhosis from five centres, a deep learning segmentation network generated spleen volume from CT, and a LASSO-Cox model was trained on 282 people from three institutions. It was validated in two external cohorts (97 and 310 people), with C-index of at least 0.84, outperforming serum-based models and the Baveno VII criteria. The study is retrospective and median follow-up was 37.6 months.
ai_technology: Deep learning spleen segmentation network feeding a LASSO-Cox prediction model
organization: Zhongda Hospital Southeast University; Southeast University
